<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

With `--enable-encoder-swa-bounded-replay` on HIP, the radix tree still kept an SWA component because the DSpark draft read its SWA through the target's paged mapping, each cached-prefix prefill ran a separate replay forward, and decode / target-verify copied the SWA window ring <-> workspace on every layer. Together these cost hits and decode time.

## Modifications

Three commits, reviewable one by one:

- Draft SWA ring on HIP: `uses_draft_swa_ring()` is true on HIP too (except unified_kv triton) and the pool keeps `swa_valid_from` for it; the HIP radix backend writes the draft block's SWA rows into the ring and skips the full-to-SWA translation.
- Folded replay: HIP folds each hit's replay rows into its extend (`SGLANG_HIP_FOLD_ENCODER_SWA_REPLAY`, default on); extend and late-layer tail rows are floored at the request's replay start via `encoder_swa_row_floor`, MLP-sync padding rows get floor 0.
- In-place decode window: decode / verify rows address the per-request ring directly (`slot * capacity + pos % capacity`), so `buffer()` returns the ring and `commit()` updates the tags once per forward; prefill / extend / replay keep the workspace. `SGLANG_HIP_REQUEST_WINDOW_DIRECT` (default on) switches back.
- Unit tests: folded-replay floor, and the in-place window bit-exact against the workspace path (decode / verify / floor).

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K 5-shot, 1319 questions, 2x MI355X TP2, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash + DSpark + encoder replay: main 0.889 -> 0.906.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

AgentX trace replay c64 PDI 8, same setup: TTT/GPU 157,543 -> 174,697 (+10.9%), TPOT p50 13.95 -> 11.84 ms, P90 interactivity 57.3 -> 65.5.
Decode bs16 / bs64 ctx 32k: window kernels -44 to -49 ms of GPU time per 40 steps.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

     commit_mask: torch.Tensor
     size: int
+    # Rows address the ring itself (indices / write_loc are ring rows); no workspace.
+    direct: bool = False
 
     def leading_rows(self, num_rows: int) -> "WindowLayout":
         """The layout of the live queries; a prefill CUDA graph pads the rest."""
@@ -180,6 +185,54 @@ def window_layout(
     )
 
 
+def direct_window_layout(
+    req,
+    pos,
+    *,
+    capacity: int,
+    window: int = 128,
+    floor: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+):
+    """Window layout over the per-request ring (row ``req * capacity + pos % capacity``).
+
+    Only for forwards whose rows are each request's newest positions (decode,
+    target-verify): with ``capacity >= window + rows_per_request - 1`` a row this
+    forward writes never aliases a row another of its queries still reads, so the
+    store can land in the ring before attention."""
+    n = pos.numel()
+    if n == 0:
+        raise ValueError("request-window layout needs at least one query")
+    req = req.to(torch.int64)
+    pos = pos.to(torch.int64)
+    device = pos.device
+    seen_pos = pos[:, None] - torch.arange(window, device=device)
+    valid = seen_pos >= 0
+    if floor is not None:
+        valid &= seen_pos >= floor.to(torch.int64)[:, None]
+    indices = torch.where(valid, req[:, None] * capacity + seen_pos % capacity, -1).to(
+        torch.int32
+    )
+    lengths = valid.sum(-1).to(torch.int32)
+    write_loc = (req * capacity + pos % capacity).to(torch.int32)
+    empty = torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+    no_rows = torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
+    return WindowLayout(
+        req,
+        pos,
+        write_loc,
+        indices,
+        lengths,
+        empty,
+        empty,
+        empty,
+        no_rows,
+        empty,
+        no_rows,
+        0,
+        direct=True,
+    )
+
+
 def copy_packed_tokens(src, dst, src_loc, dst_loc, *, page_size, layout=KVLayout.V4):
     """Move tokens between paged buffers of ``layout``: a data row and a scale row."""
     if not src_loc.numel():
@@ -223,6 +276,8 @@ def __init__(
         self.layout = None
         self.prepared = None
         self._idle_layout = None
+        self._tags_layout = None

+"""Direct (in-ring) decode / verify windows see and leave the same SWA state as the workspace path."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.dsv4.kv_layout import KVLayout
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.dsv41_request_window import (
+    RequestWindow,
+    copy_packed_tokens,
+    direct_window_layout,
+    window_layout,
+)
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_hip
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=20, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+PAGE, LAYOUT, WINDOW = 16, KVLayout.V4, 128
+
+
+def make_pool(size, layers):
+    pages = (size + PAGE - 1) // PAGE
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        kv_buffer=[
+            torch.zeros(
+                pages, LAYOUT.page_bytes(PAGE), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda"
+            )
+            for _ in range(layers)
+        ],
+        kv_layout=LAYOUT,
+        size=pages * PAGE,
+    )
+
+
+def make_window(num_slots, layers, max_draft):
+    return RequestWindow(
+        make_pool,
+        num_slots=num_slots,
+        layers=layers,
+        page_size=PAGE,
+        capacity=WINDOW + max_draft,
+        workspace_rows=(num_slots + 1) * WINDOW + 64,
+    )
+
+
+def gather(buf, indices):
+    valid = indices >= 0
+    src = indices[valid].to(torch.int64)
+    out = make_pool(max(1, src.numel()), 1).kv_buffer[0]
+    dst = torch.arange(src.numel(), device="cuda")
+    copy_packed_tokens(buf, out, src, dst, page_size=PAGE, layout=LAYOUT)
+    return out, valid
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(is_hip(), "the in-place request window is HIP-only")
+class TestRequestWindowDirect(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+
+    def _seed_history(self, win, committed):
+        for buf in win.state.kv_buffer:
+            buf.copy_(
+                torch.randint(0, 256, buf.shape, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+            )
+        for slot, length in committed.items():
+            pos = torch.arange(max(0, length - win.capacity), length, device="cuda")
+            win.tags[:, slot * win.capacity + pos % win.capacity] = pos
+
+    def _run(self, win, layout, new_rows):
+        win.activate(layout)
+        seen = []
+        n = layout.pos.numel()
+        for layer, new in enumerate(new_rows):
+            buf = win.buffer(layer)
+            copy_packed_tokens(
+                new,
+                buf,
+                torch.arange(n, device="cuda"),
+                layout.write_loc,
+                page_size=PAGE,
+                layout=LAYOUT,
+            )
+            seen.append(gather(buf, layout.indices))
+            win.commit(layer)
+        return seen
+
+    def _check(self, rows_per_request, floor_back=None):
+        layers, slots, max_draft = 3, 5, 5
+        committed = {0: 700, 2: 37, 3: 129, 4: 3}
+        order = [2, 0, 4, 3]
+        req = torch.tensor(
+            [s for s in order for _ in range(rows_per_request)], device="cuda"
+        )
+        pos = torch.tensor(
+            [committed[s] + i for s in order for i in range(rows_per_request)],
+            device="cuda",
+        )
+        # A floor is per request (its replay start), shared by all of its rows.
+        floor = (
+            None
+            if floor_back is None
+            else torch.tensor(
+                [
+                    max(0, committed[s] - floor_back)
+                    for s in order
+                    for _ in range(rows_per_request)
+                ],
+                device="cuda",
+            )
+        )
+
+        ref = make_window(slots, layers, max_draft)
+        self._seed_history(ref, committed)
+        new = make_window(slots, layers, max_draft)
+        for a, b in zip(ref.state.kv_buffer, new.state.kv_buffer):
+            b.copy_(a)
+        new.tags.copy_(ref.tags)
+        new_rows = [
+            make_pool(pos.numel(), 1).kv_buffer[0].random_(0, 256)
+            for _ in range(layers)
+        ]
+
+        old_layout = window_layout(
+            req,
+            pos,
+            zero_row=ref.zero_row,
+            capacity=ref.capacity,
+            floor=floor,
+            num_groups=len(order),
+        )
+        direct = direct_window_layout(req, pos, capacity=new.capacity, floor=floor)
+        self.assertTrue(direct.direct)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(direct.lengths, old_layout.lengths, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+        seen_ref = self._run(ref, old_layout, new_rows)
+        seen_new = self._run(new, direct, new_rows)
+        for (a, va), (b, vb) in zip(seen_ref, seen_new):
+            torch.testing.assert_close(va, vb, rtol=0, atol=0)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(a, b, rtol=0, atol=0)
+        for a, b in zip(ref.state.kv_buffer, new.state.kv_buffer):
+            torch.testing.assert_close(a, b, rtol=0, atol=0)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(ref.tags, new.tags, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+    def test_decode_matches_workspace_path(self):
+        self._check(rows_per_request=1)
+
+    def test_verify_matches_workspace_path(self):
+        self._check(rows_per_request=5)
+
+    def test_floor_matches_workspace_path(self):
+        self._check(rows_per_request=5, floor_back=50)
+
+    def test_direct_buffer_is_the_ring(self):
+        win = make_window(2, 2, 5)
+        layout = direct_window_layout(
+            torch.tensor([1], device="cuda"),
+            torch.tensor([200], device="cuda"),
+            capacity=win.capacity,
+        )
+        win.activate(layout)
+        self.assertEqual(win.buffer(1).data_ptr(), win.state.kv_buffer[1].data_ptr())
+
+    def test_reused_layout_retags_every_forward(self):
+        win = make_window(2, 3, 5)
+        req = torch.tensor([1], device="cuda")
+        pos = torch.tensor([10], device="cuda")
+        layout = direct_window_layout(req, pos.clone(), capacity=win.capacity)
+        win.activate(layout)
+        for step in range(3):
+            # A graph bucket refreshes its layout in place, keeping the object.
+            layout.copy_(direct_window_layout(req, pos + step, capacity=win.capacity))
+            for layer in range(3):
+                win.commit(layer)
+            row = 1 * win.capacity + (10 + step) % win.capacity
+            self.assertEqual(win.tags[:, row].tolist(), [10 + step] * 3)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
